citation: Swink, Floyd and Gerould Wilhelm. Plants of the Chicago Region, 4th edition. Indiana Academy of Science, Indianapolis, 1994. Extended by Wilhelm, Gerould and Laura Rericha, Flora of the Chicago Region: A Floristic and Ecological Synthesis, Indiana Academy of Science, 2017.
author: Floyd Swink and Gerould Wilhelm
access_notes: A print flora, in copyright; no copy was retrieved in this session. Species assignments cited to it here come through the committed dossier docs/research/02-flora.md.
note: The definitive regional flora, with community-fidelity (C) values. Its most important use in this project is EXCLUSION: it is the authority for keeping species that do not belong in the Chicago region out of the records.
what_it_supplies: which species belong to which Chicago-region community
what_it_does_not_supply: any record of what grew on the Chicago town site in 1835; a species on its regional list is inferred for this site, never documented, unless a period account names it
